body:
## Story Points: 8 | Priority: P1 | Sprint: 2

## Summary
Administrators configure parking rates; customers create advance slot reservations.

## Rate Schedule (VPS-F-014)
- GET /api/v1/admin/rates - list all (ADMINISTRATOR only)
- POST /api/v1/admin/rates - create (name, vehicleType, ratePerHour, gracePeriodMinutes)
- PUT /api/v1/admin/rates/{id} - update
- ratePerHour > 0 and gracePeriodMinutes >= 0 validated
- Seed: 4 rates (CAR=30, MOTORCYCLE=15, TRUCK=60, EV=20 INR/hr)

## Reservations (VPS-F-011, VPS-F-012)
- POST /api/v1/reservations: own vehicle only; startTime in future; endTime > startTime
- Conflict check: no overlapping CONFIRMED reservations on same slot
- GET /api/v1/reservations: own for CUSTOMER; all for ADMINISTRATOR
- DELETE /api/v1/reservations/{id}: cancel own or admin
- POST /api/v1/reservations/expire: PARKING_ATTENDANT or ADMINISTRATOR only

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Customer cannot create or modify rate schedules (403)
- [ ] Reservation conflict returns 403
- [ ] Customer cannot cancel another user's reservation (403)

## Definition of Done
Rates configurable by admin; reservations created with conflict check; expiry endpoint restricted to staff.
